overviewParagraphs: Custom stuffed hanging ornaments are soft, filled textile pieces with a hanging loop, produced in fully custom shapes. They combine plush structure with full-color printed or embroidered detailing for a tactile, premium finish.

They are used widely for seasonal retail, holiday collections, character merchandise and promotional gifts where a soft, three-dimensional product makes a stronger impression than a flat printed item.

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for stuffed hanging ornaments?
faqs.answer: MOQ: 200 pcs per design and construction for bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I request a pre-production sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production sample development is available for custom projects so you can verify shape, fill and detailing before bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I submit an inquiry without final artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can submit your project now and send artwork later, or provide a sketch or reference image for our team to review.

faqs.question: What design files can I send?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI or SVG files work well. For custom shapes, a clear outline or reference of the desired contour is helpful.

faqs.question: Can you help choose the right detailing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team can recommend printed, embroidered or mixed detailing based on your artwork and desired finish.

faqs.question: Can you provide test reports?
faqs.answer: Test reports and compliance documentation can be supported according to selected materials, product construction and destination-market requirements.

faqs.question: How are ornaments packed and shipped?
faqs.answer: Individual or bulk packing is available, and shipment is arranged according to your confirmed order, destination and payment terms.
